pages.title: Electric Pylon
pages.text: The Electric Pylon is the most basic power distribution node. It delivers grid power to nearby devices.$(br2)Grid Connection Range: 30m$(br)Supply Range: 10m (centered on the pylon)

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: Place the pylon within 30m of a Protocol Core or Relay Tower — it auto-connects to the grid.$(br2)Devices requiring power (refining units, shredders, towers, etc.) placed within 10m of the pylon will automatically receive power.$(br2)Pylons themselves consume no power to operate.
Check the exact recipe in the Crafter. Required materials can be looked up in REI/JEI.
